s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic pruritic skin condition with erythematous papules and lymphoid infiltrate
salient_findings: Erythematous papules with crusts and excoriations on the trunk and upper extremities
Scales and fissures on the lower lip with sparing of the surrounding skin
key_facts: Female patient in her early 40s
No other medical history
Topical corticosteroids ineffective in controlling symptoms
Physical examination revealed erythematous papules, crusts, and excoriations
Scales and fissures on the lower lip
Normal blood test results including antinuclear antibodies and complement
Normal urine porphyrin analysis
Skin biopsy showed spongiosis and erosions in the epidermis
Nodular lymphocyte infiltrate in the upper and mid dermis
CD20 positive and BCL-2 negative cells in the germinal center
Phototest with solar simulator showed delayed erythema to UV-A

shortlist.label: Cutaneous B-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Nodular lymphocyte infiltrate and CD20 positive cells in skin biopsy

shortlist.label: Primary cutaneous follicle center lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Germinal center formation and BCL-2 negative cells in biopsy

shortlist.label: Cutaneous marginal zone lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Nodular lymphocyte infiltrate and lymphoid follicles in dermis

shortlist.label: Mycosis fungoides
shortlist.why_kept: Erythematous papules and lymphoid infiltrate, although less likely due to absence of typical MF features

shortlist.label: Pityriasis lichenoides chronica
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic pruritic skin condition with erythematous papules, although biopsy features not fully typical

raw.rationale: The presence of a nodular lymphocyte infiltrate in the upper and mid dermis with a peripheral mantle zone surrounding a central germinal center, along with CD20 positive and BCL-2 negative cells, is characteristic of primary cutaneous follicle center lymphoma

rejected.label: Cutaneous B-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: Too broad, as primary cutaneous follicle center lymphoma is a specific subtype of cutaneous B-cell lymphoma

rejected.label: Cutaneous marginal zone lymphoma
rejected.why: Typically shows a more diffuse infiltrate and plasma cell differentiation, not seen in this case

rejected.label: Mycosis fungoides
rejected.why: Typically presents with epidermotropic atypical lymphocytes and Pautrier's microabscesses, not seen in this case

rejected.label: Pityriasis lichenoides chronica
rejected.why: Typically shows a more superficial perivascular infiltrate and lack of germinal centers
